background: National Australia Bank is one of Australia's big four banks and the largest business lender in the country, funded by Australian and New Zealand deposits and wholesale markets, with BNZ as its New Zealand subsidiary.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 26 May 2024. The figures sit close to the middle of Australian banks: CET1 of 11.9% is just below the peer median, while leverage of 4.8%, LCR of 135% and NSFR of 116% are at or above it. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Sep 2026, and there has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
